about: The steps of `python -m pitchiq process_match`, in order, as the coach page shows them. Read by coach/run.js (the estimate and the progress bar) and pitchiq/run_progress.py (the time left). `min` is the low and high minutes a step took on the processing PC: the pass from the 18 halves in pitchiq/balltrack/half/*/log.txt (52-123 min), the rest from the timings in process_match's docstring, widened to the Woodbridge full run of 2026-11-19 (panoramas 15-16, map 29-37 with 5 processes); stats from the table, 129-132 s a half on Woodbridge (2026-11-21). The passes and the ball from the timing run of 2026-11-23 (game wbt, 6 h 00 in all): the first pass starts with the camera step, beside the panoramas, so its minutes are only what is left of it after the calibration (77 min in all); the second pass 68 min with fast cores; the ball 205 min with 60-frame bridges. `you` marks the step that waits for the coach. `beside` marks a step that runs at the same time as another (the maps beside the ball step, since 2026-11-21): it adds no time to the estimate.
